patthana21.26:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā hetu sekho dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ na
patthana21.26:2.1: asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu asekho dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ na nevasekhānāsekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu nevasekhānāsekho dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. na na hetuṃ na nevasekhānāsekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu nevasekhā nāsekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
